title: What's New — Fix + Optimize Reliability
summary: Fix + Optimize now handles both new and legacy driver-result shapes safely and surfaces any finalization failure as a real process row instead of an unexplained red warning.

items.heading: Driver summary crash fixed
items.detail: The final Fix + Optimize summary now reads UpdatedCount from the PulseGuard Driver Engine and falls back to the legacy Installed field only when present, preventing StrictMode PropertyNotFoundException failures.

items.heading: Errors now match the process list
items.detail: If a post-workflow finalization error ever occurs, PulseGuard adds a visible failed Finalizing optimization results row so the red status icon and process list cannot disagree.

items.heading: Accurate completion state
items.detail: A successful set of recorded repair steps is no longer mislabeled as a safety/preflight failure just because the final results summary encountered an exception.
